rules.condition: FEAT-004, FEAT-006 and FEAT-007 are selected by a parameter at elaboration
rules.statement: FEAT-004, FEAT-006 and FEAT-007 must be selected by an elaboration-time parameter and be present or absent, not enabled or disabled at run time.
CFG-MIN must be based on CFG-APB4 with FEAT-004, FEAT-006 and FEAT-007 disabled, ADDR_W 1 and DATA_W 8, as the smallest legal instance verified by TEST-014.
Parameter combinations listed as illegal in Section 8 must not be used.
